drivingQuestion: When may a judge who argued for acquittal switch to conviction?
outcomeNote: Rav's limitation, challenged in the next unit

segments.he: דִּינֵי נְפָשׁוֹת: הַמְלַמֵּד כּוּ׳. אָמַר רַב: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא בִּשְׁעַת מַשָּׂא וּמַתָּן, אֲבָל בִּשְׁעַת גְּמַר דִּין – מְלַמֵּד זְכוּת חוֹזֵר וּמְלַמֵּד חוֹבָה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: In cases of «capital law, one who» initially «teaches» a reason to deem the accused liable may then teach a reason to acquit, but one who initially teaches a reason to acquit him may not return and teach a reason to deem him liable. «Rav says: They taught» this halakha «only with regard to the time of» the «deliberations» of the court, «but at the time of» the «verdict,» one who initially «teaches» a reason to «acquit may return and teach» a reason to deem him «liable.»
